title: write returns a String; embedded, it is an escaped blob
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: typeOf confirms it is just a String. Sitting inside the envelope it shows up as `\r\n`, not real line breaks — that is what a JSON string does to any text with newlines in it, and it is exactly what should happen here.
